name: CHEM 3210
title: Descriptive Inorganic Chemistry
description: Introduction to bonding, structure, physical properties, and reactivity of the elements, as determined by their position in the periodic table. May be repeated for a total of 3 credits.
requirement_description: CHEM 1126Q or 1128Q or 1138Q or 1148Q. May not be taken out of sequence after passing CHEM 3214.
